newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pharmacia & Upjohn drops on Q1 sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn drops on Q1 sales fall.

text.p: Shares in drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn plummeted on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Wednesday after the company said sales fell six percent in the fist quarter of 1997.
At 1205 GMT, the share was down 21 crowns at 248, while the exchange's general index was 0.85 percent higher at 2,641.07.
"It's the lower sales and profit that are pulling the share lower," a dealer said.
The company said it expected earnings per share before non-recurring charges to drop by about 16 percent.
P&U spokesman Jacob Kaluski told Reuters the company would hold a teleconference for journalists with finance director Bob Salisbury at 1230 GMT followed by a telephone conference with analysts.
